# 1) Read in File ====
This section of the code reads in the file and makes the function that makes the plots.
```{r}
#Set plot directories
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggnewscale)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

#Set results files
rsparsepro_file="C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/RSparsePro_Robustness_Testing/combined_results.rsparsepro.tsv"
susie_file="C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/RSparsePro_Robustness_Testing/combined_results.susie.tsv"
carma_file="C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/RSparsePro_Robustness_Testing/combined_results.carma.tsv"
#Read in the results files
rsparsepro_df <- read.csv(rsparsepro_file, sep="\t")
susie_df <- read.csv(susie_file, sep="\t")
carma_df <- read.csv(carma_file, sep="\t")

#Split locus name up by simulation parameters
rsparsepro_df <- rsparsepro_df %>% dplyr::mutate(population=str_sub(locus, start=1, end=3))
susie_df <- susie_df %>% dplyr::mutate(population=str_sub(locus, start=1, end=3))
carma_df <- carma_df %>% dplyr::mutate(population=str_sub(locus, start=1, end=3))

#Add rows to carma df for trials that failed to converge in given number of retries
test = rsparsepro_df %>% left_join(carma_df, by=c("locus", "ld_mismatch_degree")) %>%
  mutate(num_causal_variants.y = num_causal_variants.x, population.y=population.x)
test = test[c("locus", "ld_mismatch_degree", "iterations", colnames(test)[str_ends(colnames(test), "[.]y")])]
carma_df = test
colnames(carma_df) <- str_replace(colnames(carma_df), "[.]y", replacement = "")
remove(test)

```

# 3) Create Power vs Coverage Plotting Function for RSparsePro Only ====
```{r}
create_power_coverage_plot <- function(data, point_size = 3, add_smooth = FALSE) {

  # Validate input data
  required_cols <- c("population", "locus", "num_causal_variants", 
                     "num_credible_sets", "coverage", "power", "ld_mismatch_degree")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Convert LD mismatch degree to numeric traits
  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      num_traits = suppressWarnings(case_when(
        ld_mismatch_degree == "unmodified" ~ Inf,
        .default = parse_number(str_replace(as.character(ld_mismatch_degree), "_traits", ""))
      )),
      # Create ordered factor for plotting
      ld_numeric = factor(num_traits, 
                         levels = c(50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, Inf),
                         labels = c("50", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "1000", "∞")),
      factor_num_causal_variants = as.factor(num_causal_variants)
    )
  
  # Aggregate data with weights
  plot_data <- processed_data %>%
    group_by(population, ld_numeric, num_traits, factor_num_causal_variants) %>%
    summarise(
      weighted_coverage = weighted.mean(coverage, w = num_credible_sets, na.rm = TRUE),
      weighted_power = weighted.mean(power, w = num_causal_variants, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Generate population-specific color palettes
  n_ld <- length(unique(plot_data$ld_numeric))
  
  eur_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[1:9])(n_ld)
  afr_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Reds")[1:9])(n_ld)
  
  # Combine colors with infinite value (black)
  color_values <- c(
    setNames(eur_colors[1:length(eur_colors)-1], paste0("EUR_", head(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), -1))),
    setNames(afr_colors[1:length(afr_colors)-1], paste0("AFR_", head(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), -1))),
    "EUR_∞" = eur_colors[length(eur_colors)],  # Darkest blue
    "AFR_∞" = afr_colors[length(afr_colors)]   # Darkest red
  )
  
  # Create combined population-LD factor
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(pop_ld = factor(paste0(population, "_", ld_numeric)))
  
  # Create base plot
  main_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = weighted_power, y = weighted_coverage,
                             fill = pop_ld)) +
    geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.8, shape=21, color="black") +
    facet_grid(population ~ factor_num_causal_variants) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.7, 1), xlim = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "LD Mismatch Degree (Number of Traits)",
      values = color_values,
      labels = rep(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), 2)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Power",
      y = "Coverage",
      title = "Number of Causal Variants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size=12),
      axis.title = element_text(size=14),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top"))
  
  # Create legend grid data
  legend_data <- expand.grid(
    population = c("EUR", "AFR"),
    ld_numeric = levels(processed_data$ld_numeric),
    stringsAsFactors = TRUE
  ) %>% dplyr::arrange(population, ld_numeric) %>% dplyr::mutate(unique_name=paste(population, ld_numeric, sep="_"))
  
  # Create legend plot
  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = ld_numeric, y = population)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = unique_name), color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_values) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = levels(legend_data$ld_numeric), labels = c(levels(legend_data$ld_numeric)[1:length(levels(legend_data$ld_numeric))-1], "Unmodified")) +
    labs(x = "Degree of LD Mismatch (Number of Traits)", y = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = c("#08306B", "#67000D")),
      strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size=10)
    )
  
  # Combine plots
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    main_plot,
    legend_plot,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(4, 1)
  )
}


```
# 4) Call Power vs. Coverage Plotting Function for Trait-Level DFs ====
```{r}
create_power_coverage_plot(rsparsepro_trait_df)
```
# 5) Create Number of Credible Sets Plotting Function ====
```{r}
create_faceted_barplot <- function(data, bar_width = 0.8) {
  # Load required packages
  if (!require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'dplyr' is required")
  if (!require(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required")
  if (!require(ggh4x, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'ggh4x' is required")
  
  # Validate input data
  required_cols <- c("population", "num_causal_variants", 
                     "ld_mismatch_degree", "num_credible_sets")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Process data
  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      ld_mismatch_degree = factor(
        ld_mismatch_degree,
        levels = c("50_traits", "100_traits", "200_traits", "300_traits",
                   "400_traits", "500_traits", "1000_traits", "unmodified"),
        labels = c("50", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "1000", "∞")
      ),
      population = factor(population, levels = c("EUR", "AFR")),
      num_causal_variants = factor(num_causal_variants)
    ) %>%
    group_by(population, num_causal_variants, ld_mismatch_degree) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_credible_sets = mean(num_credible_sets, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_credible_sets = sd(num_credible_sets, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Create base plot
  p <- ggplot(processed_data, 
              aes(x = ld_mismatch_degree, y = mean_credible_sets, fill = population)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = bar_width), 
             color = "black", width = bar_width) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_credible_sets - se_credible_sets,
                      ymax = mean_credible_sets + se_credible_sets),
                  position = position_dodge(width = bar_width), 
                  width = 0.2, color = "black") +
    facet_grid(population ~ num_causal_variants, scales = "free_y") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("EUR" = "#08306B", "AFR" = "#67000D")) +
    labs(
      x = "LD Mismatch Degree (Number of Traits)",
      y = "Average Number of Credible Sets per Locus",
      title = "Number of Causal Variants",
      fill = "Population"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  return(p)
}

```
# 6) Call Number of Credible Sets Plotting Function for Trait-Level DFs ====
```{r}
create_faceted_barplot(rsparsepro_trait_df)
```

```{r}
create_faceted_size_barplot <- function(data, bar_width = 0.8) {

  if (!require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'dplyr' is required")

                     "ld_mismatch_degree", "num_credible_sets", "credible_set_sizes")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Process data

    mutate(
      ld_mismatch_degree = factor(
        ld_mismatch_degree,

                   "400_traits", "500_traits", "1000_traits", "unmodified"),
        labels = c("50", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "1000", "∞")
      ),
      population = factor(population, levels = c("EUR", "AFR")),
      num_causal_variants = factor(num_causal_variants)
    ) %>%
    group_by(population, num_causal_variants, ld_mismatch_degree) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_credible_sets = mean(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(credible_set_sizes,","))), na.rm = TRUE),
      se_credible_sets = sd(as.numeric(unlist(str_split(credible_set_sizes,","))), na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = 'drop'

    facet_grid(population ~ num_causal_variants, scales = "free_y") +

      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  return(p)
}
```

# 9) Create Plotting Function for Top Signal Coverage and Power ====

```{r}
create_top_power_coverage_plot <- function(data, point_size = 3, add_smooth = FALSE) {

  # Validate input data
  required_cols <- c("population", "locus", "num_causal_variants", 
                     "num_credible_sets", "top_coverage", "top_power", "ld_mismatch_degree")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Convert LD mismatch degree to numeric traits
  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      num_traits = suppressWarnings(case_when(
        ld_mismatch_degree == "unmodified" ~ Inf,
        .default = parse_number(str_replace(as.character(ld_mismatch_degree), "_traits", ""))
      )),
      # Create ordered factor for plotting
      ld_numeric = factor(num_traits, 
                         levels = c(50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, Inf),
                         labels = c("50", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "1000", "∞")),
      factor_num_causal_variants = as.factor(num_causal_variants)
    )
  
  # Aggregate data with weights
  plot_data <- processed_data %>%
    group_by(population, ld_numeric, num_traits, factor_num_causal_variants) %>%
    summarise(
      average_top_coverage = mean(top_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
      average_top_power = mean(top_power, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Generate population-specific color palettes
  n_ld <- length(unique(plot_data$ld_numeric))
  
  eur_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[1:9])(n_ld)
  afr_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Reds")[1:9])(n_ld)
  
  # Combine colors with infinite value (black)
  color_values <- c(
    setNames(eur_colors[1:length(eur_colors)-1], paste0("EUR_", head(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), -1))),
    setNames(afr_colors[1:length(afr_colors)-1], paste0("AFR_", head(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), -1))),
    "EUR_∞" = eur_colors[length(eur_colors)],  # Darkest blue
    "AFR_∞" = afr_colors[length(afr_colors)]   # Darkest red
  )
  
  # Create combined population-LD factor
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(pop_ld = factor(paste0(population, "_", ld_numeric)))
  
  # Create base plot
  main_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = average_top_power, y = average_top_coverage,
                             fill = pop_ld)) +
    geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.8, shape=21, color="black") +
    facet_grid(population ~ factor_num_causal_variants) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.7, 1), xlim = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "LD Mismatch Degree (Number of Traits)",
      values = color_values,
      labels = rep(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), 2)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Power of Top Signals",
      y = "Coverage of Top Credible Sets",
      title = "Number of Causal Variants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size=12),
      axis.title = element_text(size=14),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top"))
  
  # Create legend grid data
  legend_data <- expand.grid(
    population = c("EUR", "AFR"),
    ld_numeric = levels(processed_data$ld_numeric),
    stringsAsFactors = TRUE
  ) %>% dplyr::arrange(population, ld_numeric) %>% dplyr::mutate(unique_name=paste(population, ld_numeric, sep="_"))
  
  # Create legend plot
  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = ld_numeric, y = population)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = unique_name), color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_values) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = levels(legend_data$ld_numeric), labels = c(levels(legend_data$ld_numeric)[1:length(levels(legend_data$ld_numeric))-1], "Unmodified")) +
    labs(x = "Degree of LD Mismatch (Number of Traits)", y = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = c("#08306B", "#67000D")),
      strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size=10)
    )
  
  # Combine plots
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    main_plot,
    legend_plot,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(4, 1)
  )
}
```

```{r}
create_first_signal_barplot <- function(data, bar_width = 0.8) {
  # Load required packages
  if (!require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'dplyr' is required")

      title = "Number of Causal Variants",
      fill = "Population"

      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),

      panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
```

# 13) Create a function to plot failure rate of SuSiE ====
```{r}
create_susie_failure_barplot <- function(data, bar_width = 0.8) {
  # Load required packages
  if (!require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'dplyr' is required")
  if (!require(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required")
  if (!require(ggh4x, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'ggh4x' is required")
  
  # Validate input data
  required_cols <- c("population", "num_causal_variants", 
                     "ld_mismatch_degree", "mapping_status")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Process data
  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      ld_mismatch_degree = factor(
        ld_mismatch_degree,
        levels = c("50_traits", "100_traits", "200_traits", "300_traits",
                   "400_traits", "500_traits", "1000_traits", "unmodified"),
        labels = c("50", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "1000", "Unmodified")
      ),
      population = factor(population, levels = c("EUR", "AFR")),
      num_causal_variants = factor(num_causal_variants)
    ) %>%
    group_by(population, num_causal_variants, ld_mismatch_degree, mapping_status) %>%
    summarise(
      count=n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Create base plot
  p <- ggplot(processed_data, 
              aes(x = ld_mismatch_degree, y = count, fill = mapping_status)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", 
             color = "black", width = bar_width) +
    facet_grid(population ~ num_causal_variants, scales = "free_y") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("converged" = "darkgreen", "not_converged" = "gold", "error" = "#67000D"), breaks=c("converged", "not_converged", "error"), labels=c("Converged", "Not Converged", "Prior Estimation Failed")) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,0.25), labels=paste0(seq(0,100,25), "%")) + 
    labs(
      x = "LD Mismatch Degree (Number of Traits)",
      y = "Percent of Loci",
      title = "Number of Causal Variants",
      fill="Mapping Status"
    ) +
    theme(

      panel.border = element_blank(),
```

# 15) Create a function to plot failure rate of CARMA ====
```{r}
create_carma_iterations_barplot <- function(data, bar_width = 0.8) {
  # Load required packages
  if (!require(dplyr, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'dplyr' is required")
  if (!require(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required")
  if (!require(ggh4x, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'ggh4x' is required")
  
  # Validate input data
  required_cols <- c("population", "num_causal_variants", 
                     "ld_mismatch_degree", "iterations")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Process data
  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      ld_mismatch_degree = factor(
        ld_mismatch_degree,
        levels = c("50_traits", "100_traits", "200_traits", "300_traits",
                   "400_traits", "500_traits", "1000_traits", "unmodified"),
        labels = c("50", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "1000", "Unmodified")
      ),
      population = factor(population, levels = c("EUR", "AFR")),
      num_causal_variants = factor(num_causal_variants),
    ) %>% replace(is.na(.), 11) %>%
    mutate(iterations_factor=as.factor(iterations)) %>%
    group_by(population, num_causal_variants, ld_mismatch_degree, iterations_factor) %>%
    summarise(
      count=n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Create base plot
  p <- ggplot(processed_data, 
              aes(x = ld_mismatch_degree, y = count, fill = iterations_factor)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", 
             color = "black", width = bar_width) +
    facet_grid(population ~ num_causal_variants, scales = "free_y") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#f7fcf5", "#e8f6e4", "#d3edcc", "#b8e2b1", "#98d493", "#73c375", "#4bb061", "#2e974e", "#157e3a", "#006428", "#00441b"), breaks=seq(1,11,1), labels=c(seq(1,10,1), "Failed")) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,0.25), labels=paste0(seq(0,100,25), "%")) + 
    labs(
      x = "LD Mismatch Degree (Number of Traits)",
      y = "Percent of Loci",
      title = "Number of Causal Variants",
      fill="Iterations"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  return(p)
}

```

# 17) Create Power vs Coverage Plotting Function for All Three Methods ====
```{r}
create_all_power_coverage_plot <- function(data, point_size = 3, add_smooth = FALSE, xmin=0, ymin=0) {

  # Validate input data
  required_cols <- c("population", "locus", "num_causal_variants", 
                     "num_credible_sets", "coverage", "power", "ld_mismatch_degree")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Convert LD mismatch degree to numeric traits
  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      num_traits = suppressWarnings(case_when(
        ld_mismatch_degree == "unmodified" ~ Inf,
        .default = parse_number(str_replace(as.character(ld_mismatch_degree), "_traits", ""))
      )),
      # Create ordered factor for plotting
      ld_numeric = factor(num_traits, 
                         levels = c(50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, Inf),
                         labels = c("50", "100", "200", "300", "400", "500", "1000", "Unmodified")),
      factor_num_causal_variants = as.factor(num_causal_variants)
    )
  
  # Aggregate data with weights
  plot_data <- processed_data %>%
    group_by(population, ld_numeric, num_traits, factor_num_causal_variants, method) %>%
    summarise(
      weighted_coverage = weighted.mean(coverage, w = num_credible_sets, na.rm = TRUE),
      weighted_power = weighted.mean(power, w = num_causal_variants, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Generate method-specific color palettes
  n_ld <- length(unique(plot_data$ld_numeric))
  susie_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[1:9])(n_ld)
  rsparsepro_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Reds")[1:9])(n_ld)
  carma_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Greens")[1:9])(n_ld)
  
  # Combine colors with infinite value (black)
  color_values <- c(
    setNames(susie_colors[1:length(susie_colors)-1], paste0("SuSiE_", head(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), -1))),
    setNames(rsparsepro_colors[1:length(rsparsepro_colors)-1], paste0("RSparsePro_", head(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), -1))),
    setNames(carma_colors[1:length(carma_colors)-1], paste0("CARMA_", head(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), -1))),
    "SuSiE_Unmodified" = susie_colors[length(susie_colors)],  # Darkest blue
    "RSparsePro_Unmodified" = rsparsepro_colors[length(rsparsepro_colors)],   # Darkest red
    "CARMA_Unmodified" = carma_colors[length(carma_colors)] #Darkest Green
  )
  
  # Create combined population-LD factor
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(method_ld = factor(paste0(method, "_", ld_numeric)))
  
  # Create base plot
  main_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = weighted_power, y = weighted_coverage,
                             fill = method_ld)) +
    geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.8, shape=21, color="black") +
    facet_grid(population ~ factor_num_causal_variants) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ymin, 1), xlim = c(xmin, 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "LD Mismatch Degree (Number of Traits)",
      values = color_values,
      labels = rep(levels(plot_data$ld_numeric), 2)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Power",
      y = "Coverage",
      title = "Number of Causal Variants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size=12),
      axis.title = element_text(size=14),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, title.position = "top"))
  
  # Create legend grid data
  legend_data <- expand.grid(
    method = c("SuSiE", "RSparsePro", "CARMA"),
    ld_numeric = levels(processed_data$ld_numeric),
    stringsAsFactors = TRUE
  ) %>% dplyr::arrange(method, ld_numeric) %>% dplyr::mutate(unique_name=paste(method, ld_numeric, sep="_"))
  
  # Create legend plot
  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = ld_numeric, y = method)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = unique_name), color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_values) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = levels(legend_data$ld_numeric), labels = c(levels(legend_data$ld_numeric)[1:length(levels(legend_data$ld_numeric))-1], "Unmodified")) +
    labs(x = "Degree of LD Mismatch (Number of Traits)", y = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = c(susie_colors[length(susie_colors)], rsparsepro_colors[length(rsparsepro_colors)], carma_colors[length(carma_colors)])),
      strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size=8)
    )
  
  # Combine plots
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    main_plot,
    legend_plot,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(4, 1)
  )
}
```

```{r}
create_susie_failure_barplot <- function(data, bar_width = 0.8) {

      x = "LD Mismatch Degree (Noise Standard Deviation)",

      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
three_way_sd_intersect=intersect(susie_sd_thinned$unique_name, carma_sd_thinned$unique_name)

rsparsepro_three_way_sd_merge = rsparsepro_sd_df %>% mutate(unique_name=paste(locus, ld_mismatch_degree, sep = ".")) %>% dplyr::filter(unique_name %in% three_way_sd_intersect) %>% dplyr::select(all_of(required_cols)) %>% mutate(method="RSparsePro")
susie_three_way_sd_merge <- susie_sd_thinned %>% dplyr::filter(unique_name %in% three_way_sd_intersect) %>% dplyr::select(all_of(required_cols)) %>% mutate(method="SuSiE")
carma_three_way_sd_merge <- carma_sd_thinned %>% dplyr::filter(unique_name %in% three_way_sd_intersect) %>% dplyr::select(all_of(required_cols)) %>% mutate(method="CARMA")
three_way_sd_df <- rbind.data.frame(susie_three_way_sd_merge, rsparsepro_three_way_sd_merge, carma_three_way_sd_merge)
#Call plotting script
create_all_power_coverage_plot(three_way_sd_df, xmin=0.35, ymin=0.25)
```
# 26) Plot CARMA v RSparsePro results for Trait-Level DFs ====
```{r}
#Make the 2-way plot
rsparsepro_two_way_sd_merge = rsparsepro_sd_df %>% mutate(unique_name=paste(locus, ld_mismatch_degree, sep = ".")) %>% dplyr::filter(unique_name %in% carma_sd_thinned$unique_name) %>% dplyr::select(all_of(required_cols)) %>% mutate(method="RSparsePro")
carma_two_way_sd_merge <- carma_sd_thinned %>% dplyr::select(all_of(required_cols)) %>% mutate(method="CARMA")
two_way_sd_df <- rbind.data.frame(rsparsepro_two_way_sd_merge, carma_two_way_sd_merge)
#Call plotting script
create_all_power_coverage_plot(two_way_sd_df, ymin=0.4,xmin=0.35)
```
